findings.evidence: dom-375.json: the nav links "The list", "Tastings", "Find us" are display:none with zero rects, and no menu button exists; the 375 header shows only the wordmark and "Open tonight from 5pm". The footer repeats only "The list" and "Tastings".
findings.before: nav.nav__pill links hidden below the breakpoint with no replacement
findings.after: Keep the three links visible in a second row at 375px, or add a <button aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav-links">Menu</button>; add "Find us" to the footer links
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.5 Multiple Ways and 3.2.3 Consistent Navigation (advisory on a one-page site): phone users lose the page's navigation landmark content entirely. Nearest curated card A11-007 (landmarks).

strengths: Every focus stop shows a 2px salmon outline that is clearly visible on the dark ground (focus/01-on to 09-on); focus order follows the visual order top to bottom.
The email field has a visible label, type=email and autocomplete=email; the form fails honestly.
Closed days are marked by the word "Closed" as well as dimmed colour, so the hours do not rely on colour alone (1.4.1).
Footer and credit links are underlined; the logo link's name "Night Cellar, home" contains its visible label (2.5.3).
One h1, h2 per section, main/nav/header/footer landmarks, skip link first, and all text visible under reduced motion, observer-off and scripts-off.

Alt text: the three photographs were blocked in capture and no elements appear in dom-1440.json, so alt quality could not be judged.
